name: EPIC 212379246
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 8.2 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212379246 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.236026 (16th-84th percentiles 7.908306-8.565517), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212379246 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.090369 (16th-84th percentiles 0.987666-1.198547), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212379246: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4654.5 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212379246 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3429.921875 (16th-84th percentiles 3320.898438-3540.507812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.23 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,430 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.09 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,655 K at its surface.
